recipes.title: Run a PromQL query in Prometheus

steps.say: Choose the Prometheus tab at the top - Prometheus stores every metric the servers export.
Open Graph - the page where you ask Prometheus a question in PromQL.
Type the expression into the Expression box (it is the same query the console runs).
Press Execute to evaluate it now.
Keep the Table tab open and read the value on each result line (switch to Graph to see the last hour as a chart).

recipes.verify: The result appears under Table, and the query is recorded exactly as if you had typed it in the SRE Console.

steps.say: Choose the Prometheus tab.
Open Targets - one row per server Prometheus scrapes, UP or DOWN, so you can see at a glance which exporter cannot be reached.
To complete the task, also run up on the Graph page: Graph -> Expression up -> Execute.

recipes.title: Reload the Prometheus configuration

steps.say: Choose the Prometheus tab.
Open Rules - it lists the alert and recording rules Prometheus has loaded.
Press Reload configuration so Prometheus reads the rule files you just wrote.

recipes.verify: Your new rules appear in the Rules list.

steps.say: Choose the Prometheus tab.
Open Rules and check that each alert you expect is listed with no error - a rule that is not loaded can never page anybody.
Choose the Alertmanager tab at the top - Alertmanager decides who is notified about a firing alert.
Open Status.
Press Check monitoring/alertmanager.yml to validate the routing file before it is used.

recipes.title: Create a silence

steps.say: Choose the Alertmanager tab.
Open Silences - a silence mutes matching alerts for a limited time, for planned work.
Press New Silence.
Under Matchers type the label name {1}.
Type the value {2} - only alerts with exactly this label are muted.
Set Duration to {3} so the silence ends by itself.
Write the Comment - why, and who owns it.
Press Create.

recipes.verify: The silence is listed as Active with its end time.

steps.say: Choose the Alertmanager tab.
Open Silences and read the Active list.
Choose the Prometheus tab and open Alerts - each rule shows inactive, pending (waiting out its for: time) or firing.
Read the State column for your alert.
